utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Dane, I'm Nell. Have you heard about the repair drive on Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I just got here—what exactly is a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It's a community event where we help each other fix up old items like electronics, bikes, and clothes. It's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'll be there. I just finished aligning the south end, so we're on track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'm glad to hear that! Let me know if you need any help organizing supplies or tasks—I'm happy to assist.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, just let me know if you're missing anything. I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, you name it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus. Let me just... uh, check my shed again. I might've forgotten what I actually own.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Take your time, Noah. I'll be around if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive! I'll try to remember to bring that old toaster. Thanks for the reminder, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, Oren! Just remember: Saturday, community center, 10 to 4. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, Saturday, 10 to 4... I'll write it down this time so I don't forget!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, have you signed up to bring any supplies for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? I thought someone else was organizing that. Are you sure about the details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I heard it from Vik—Saturday at the community center. He seemed pretty sure about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks Mara, that would be great! Could you help gather some tools and maybe set up a sign-up sheet for volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard about that from Deb. Count me in to help with the benches.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Ira! The benches definitely need some love. I'll add you to the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great. See you both there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, do we have enough bike pumps? I can check my shed for mine.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good idea, thanks Pia. Let's see how many we have first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! Are you joining us for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly is the repair drive? I want to be clear on what we're doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where we all bring broken items—like bikes, toasters, or furniture—and fix them together. It's a fun way to learn new skills and help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey! I'm thrilled you're joining us for the repair drive. How can I help you get started?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks Rosa. I was just wondering if you know where Oren left the instructions? He mentioned his garage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I think I saw Oren leave a binder on the bench in his garage. Want me to walk over with you to find it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Uli, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, that sounds nice. I might have an old bike in the shed... I'll check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, if you find that bike, bring it along! I'm bringing my wrench set too—they mentioned they're short on tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Eli, are you planning on going to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I plan to be there. I like to have everything scheduled out, so I hope they stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you planning to bring to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday at the school. I'll see if I have anything to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let me know if you need any help organizing your items or getting them to the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam. I'll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Mara! I could use a hand sorting the tools. Want to meet at the community center Friday evening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so there really is a repair drive? Who's running it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it's organized by Mara and a few others. She's been gathering volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I heard from Deb at the store that there's a repair drive for the park benches. Do you know anything about it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Actually, Ira, it's not for park benches. The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm, fixing old electronics and furniture together!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I must have mixed that up! That sounds great, I'll definitely come by on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to hear Gus volunteered tools. I'm all for a well-organized drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, having tools lined up will make things smoother. I think we're making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let's set a date and divide tasks soon, keep things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Faye, could you tell me more about this repair drive? I want to make sure I have the right idea.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure! It's a community event where we collect old appliances and furniture, and volunteers help fix them up. We're gathering items at the school this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I see. So people bring broken appliances and furniture, and volunteers fix them? That sounds great. Do you need any particular tools or donations?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard it's for fixing old appliances at the school. Wish I could help, but I'm swamped.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it's at the community center, but maybe they changed the location? Too bad you're busy, it sounds like fun!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? What exactly does that involve?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where we fix up old items together—bikes, toasters, anything really. Everyone brings something to repair and we help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Pia, sorry, I keep zoning out. Did you say the repair drive is this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 10. I'm a bit worried about the tool shortage though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the tool shortage. I should probably dig through my garage and see what I have that might be useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Leo, I'm double-checking the drop-off points for the tool drive. Could you verify the list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, send me the list and I'll confirm by noon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo. I'll send the list right over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I have an old radio that stopped working... I might bring it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Uli! Bring it along. I'm sure the volunteers will be able to take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope they can fix it... it was my late wife's favorite.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was for park benches? So they're fixing bikes for kids too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it's definitely for bikes! But I heard they're also doing some park bench repairs later. They're short on tools though—I'm bringing my wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sorry, I forgot what that is again. Could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Oren! It's an event where people bring broken items and volunteers help fix them, to reduce waste.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I remember now! I think I have some old instructions for that in my garage. I'll go dig them up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, you need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full shed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's so generous of you, Gus! I could really use some basic repair tools like hammers and screwdrivers. Can you bring them to the school this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Mara! I'll bring a nice selection of hammers and screwdrivers to the school on Saturday morning.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
